claims.statement: The paper said the world championship was still undecided and that Tom Allen was unlikely to surrender the belt he had won.
claims.excerpt: The championship of the world is yet uvdecided, and itis by no means probable

claims.statement: Street opinion in St. Louis held that Tom Allen had been grossly wronged and that the job was set up weeks before to defeat him by foul means.
claims.excerpt: They consider that he bas been grossly wronged, and that the job was set up weeks before

fights.excerpt: They consider that he bas been grossly wronged, and that the job was set up weeks before
fights.notes: Opinion piece, not a report of the fight. It says Allen was beaten through foul means and that the fight was not a fair one.

notes: Street-opinion piece on the Goss fight; no round, place or time details.
